blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648410. Sole tracked deployment AA_FalconXUSDC 0xc26a6fa2c37b38e549a4a1807543801db684f99c is non-proxy (EIP-1967 implementation slot zero). minter() returns IdleCDO 0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d. Runtime bytecode includes burn(address,uint256) and mint but no transfer blacklist/pause/freeze selectors. Pinned IdleCDOTranche.sol exposes burn(account, amount) gated only by msg.sender == minter, which destroys that account's balance without holder authorization—a live holder-selective seize surface controlled by the minter. The minter is a transparent proxy to IdleCDOEpochVariant 0xdd596250f838af8862d30e9c78a143356894a18d; paused() returned true at the observation block. Parent IdleCDO._withdrawOps currently burns only msg.sender, but the token-level minter privilege remains an unconditional burn-any-holder capability and the CDO is upgradeable. Controlling authority: IdleCDO minter/admin over the tranche token. Failure domain: contract:ethereum:0xc26a6fa2c37b38e549a4a1807543801db684f99c plus upgradeable minter 0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d.
